evals.prompt: I just cloned this repository for the first time and I need to add a small feature. What should I know before I touch anything?
evals.expected_output: A detection pass over the repository that reports only what was observed.
expectations: The project-conventions skill was activated
Recent history and the root instruction files (AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, CLAUDE.md) are read before any rule is applied
Linter and formatter configs are reported as enforced rules
A convention that was not seen is reported as 'not detected' rather than guessed

evals.prompt: Name my branch and write the commit message for this change.
evals.expected_output: Branch and commit names that follow the observed ticket convention without inventing an ID.
expectations: The project-conventions skill was activated
The ticket ID pattern and its placement are taken from recent history or the current branch name
No ticket number is invented; the user is asked when none can be found
No ticket convention is introduced when the history shows none

evals.prompt: Where should the code for the new notifications feature live in this codebase?
evals.expected_output: A location derived from existing module layering and examples.
expectations: The project-conventions skill was activated
The decision rests on at least three existing examples of how comparable code is placed
No new layering or module scheme is introduced without evidence of one

evals.prompt: The generic guidance says to use one style of mock, but the tests in this repo do something different. Which one do I follow?
evals.expected_output: The observed repository convention wins over generic guidance.
expectations: The project-conventions skill was activated
The observed convention is chosen over the generic guidance
The choice is backed by existing examples cited from the tree

evals.prompt: I am adding the new settings page. Is there anything in this repo I am not supposed to touch?
evals.expected_output: Off-limits areas reported only if observed, with no template placeholders in the output.
expectations: The project-conventions skill was activated
Off-limits areas such as generated code, CI configuration or pinning files are reported only where the repository shows them
No unfilled placeholder text from the team template appears in the output

evals.prompt: Turn our release workflow into a reusable skill that other agents can load.
expectations: The project-conventions skill was NOT activated
The skill-creator skill was activated

evals.prompt: What is a good general branching and release strategy for a team of six that ships weekly?
evals.expected_output: Generic delivery practice, not detection of this repository's rules.
expectations: The project-conventions skill was NOT activated
The engineering-practices skill was activated

evals.prompt: Write the pull request description for this change.
evals.expected_output: A PR description document, not convention detection.
expectations: The project-conventions skill was NOT activated
The work-docs skill was activated
